label: Speak (streaming)
description: Streaming text-to-speech: a live text bus in (an LLM stream, a transcript), a live audio bus out, spoken as the text arrives, and the full audio as a file at the end. For whole text in, file out, use Speak to File. The audio bus opens with the first audio: a session refused before it is a failure `_error` can catch, and one that breaks off after it fails the run and ends the bus failed, so a cut-off stream is never mistaken for a finished one. A text bus that ended failed fails the node.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The ElevenLabs access (wire an ElevenLabsAccess node).

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The live text: plain-string messages (an LLM stream) or { text } objects (a transcript bus).

inputs.name: voice
inputs.label: Voice
inputs.placeholder: Pick a voice, or paste a voice id

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: The streaming socket speaks with Flash and Multilingual v2. ElevenLabs's v3 and v4 models do not stream through it, so use Speak to File for those. Flash costs half as much per character and answers faster, and eleven_flash_v2 speaks English only.

inputs.name: outputFormat
inputs.label: Output format
inputs.description: pcm_16000 is the audio-bus standard the other realtime nodes speak, and `alignment` needs a pcm, ulaw or alaw format. ElevenLabs gives mp3_44100_192 only on its Creator plan and above, and pcm or wav at 44100 only on Pro and above.

inputs.name: stability
inputs.description: Voice stability (0 varied, 1 monotone). Absent = the voice's own setting.

inputs.name: similarityBoost
inputs.description: How closely the output sticks to the voice. Absent = the voice's own setting.

inputs.name: speed
inputs.description: Speaking speed multiplier. Absent = the voice's own setting.

inputs.name: style
inputs.description: How much the voice exaggerates its speaker's style: 0 leaves it as it is, and higher values amplify it, which ElevenLabs says can make the answer slower.

inputs.name: speakerBoost
inputs.label: Speaker boost
inputs.description: Makes the audio sound more like the voice's original speaker, at the cost of a slightly slower answer.

inputs.name: languageCode
inputs.label: Language
inputs.description: If you want the text read as one language, give its two-letter code, like `fr`. A code the model does not support is ignored, not refused, and eleven_multilingual_v2 takes no language code at all. Leave empty to let the model decide.

inputs.name: textNormalization
inputs.label: Spell out numbers
inputs.description: Whether numbers, dates and the like are written out into words before they are spoken. Leave empty for auto, which decides per text. ElevenLabs keeps it off on Flash v2.5 by default, and only Enterprise accounts can turn it on there.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: If you want to be able to make a similar take again, set any whole number here, then run again with that number and the same text. ElevenLabs tries to give the same audio back but does not promise it. Leave empty for a new random seed each run.

inputs.name: pronunciationDictionaries
inputs.label: Pronunciation dictionaries
inputs.description: Pronunciation dictionaries of the connected ElevenLabs account, each as `{ id, version }`: the streaming socket needs the version. ElevenLabs matches a dictionary's words only inside one message of the `text` bus, and a dictionary that uses phonemes also needs `enableSsmlParsing`.

inputs.name: enableSsmlParsing
inputs.label: SSML parsing
inputs.description: Turn on if a pronunciation dictionary uses phonemes: on the streaming socket, ElevenLabs applies phoneme rules only with this on.

inputs.name: autoMode
inputs.label: Auto mode
inputs.description: On, ElevenLabs decides by itself when to turn the text so far into audio. Turn it off to set `chunkLengthSchedule`: ElevenLabs then waits until enough text has arrived to match the schedule before it speaks.

inputs.name: chunkLengthSchedule
inputs.label: Chunk schedule
inputs.description: With `autoMode` off, how many characters ElevenLabs waits for before generating: the first number before the first audio, the next before the second, and the last for every chunk after that. Each is between 50 and 500. Leave empty for ElevenLabs's 120, 160, 250, 290. Smaller numbers answer sooner and can sound worse.

inputs.name: enableLogging
inputs.label: Keep history
inputs.description: Turn off for zero retention: ElevenLabs then keeps no history of the session. Only Enterprise accounts can turn it off.

outputs.name: audio
outputs.description: The live audio: raw byte frames in the declared format (bus metadata carries sample_rate and encoding).

outputs.name: alignment
outputs.description: When wired, the timing of each spoken character, live: one message per audio frame, a list of `{ text, start, end }` in seconds from the start of the whole speech. Needs a pcm, ulaw or alaw `outputFormat`.

outputs.name: file
outputs.description: The whole spoken audio, stored when the stream ends.

then.message: ElevenLabsSpeak '{id}' picks a v3 or v4 `model`, and ElevenLabs's streaming text to speech socket takes neither: pick a Flash or Multilingual v2 `model`, or speak v3 and v4 with ElevenLabsSpeakFile.
ElevenLabsSpeak '{id}' sets `languageCode`, and eleven_multilingual_v2 takes no language code: pick another `model`, or leave `languageCode` empty.

ElevenLabsSpeak '{id}' sets `chunkLengthSchedule` with `autoMode` on, and in auto mode ElevenLabs decides when to generate without waiting on a schedule: turn `autoMode` off, or leave `chunkLengthSchedule` empty.

ElevenLabsSpeak '{id}' wires `alignment`, which places each character on the whole speech by counting the audio bytes before it, and only the pcm, ulaw and alaw formats pin that down exactly: pick one of those for `outputFormat`, or leave `alignment` unwired.
ElevenLabsSpeak '{id}' has a `chunkLengthSchedule` number outside 50 to 500, and ElevenLabs takes each number of characters between 50 and 500: keep each one in that range.
